notes.title: Halloween Update: Steam Scream - The Revenge! ver.0.41.4992
notes.notes:
Halloween Update: Steam Scream - The Revenge!
Celebrate Halloween with some spooky changes! Here's what's new:


Easier Quests
We've made all the stages easier to play.

Clear Minimap in Easy Mode
On Easy mode, the minimap is now much clearer, showing all paths and crawlspaces.

Narrower Levels
The levels are now smaller and more focused.

Main Quests Only
You only need to complete the main quests to win the game.

New Striped Costume
Get into the Halloween spirit with a new striped costume!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554409/0baa7587c6a9e958facb85bef1172dfddcd2db93.gif

Witch Hat Accessory
Top off your costume with a cool Witch Hat!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554409/e5120a7e8de90381dfab55b501ac28164382a0f0.gif


Enjoy the spooky season with Steam Scream: The Revenge!

notes.title: Patch Note v.0.39.4367
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554409/0cbf97dac8ab8692aebd389b8d9b454c171b7c9c.png

New Feature: Easy / Normal / Hard / Hell
We've added four different difficulty modes to our game: Easy, Normal, Hard, and Hell.
Each mode comes with its own set of challenges and rewards, so you can choose the one that suits your skills and preferences best.
You can select difficulty in the lobby before start game.
Different difficulty modes will effect to Holes, Minimap, Ghost, and Items.
